The '''Abroganto scientific research precinct''' was a region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], an antidote to a [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]] developed by the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]] was manufactured by a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Unidentified Corellian medchem company|medchem company]] that operated from the precinct.<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Siege" />
